meta.description: Personal English learning platform — courses, vocabulary, grammar, listening, and progress tracking tailored to your CEFR level.
meta.landingTitle: EnglishFlow — Learn English with a system built around you.

marketing.heroTitle: Learn English with a system built around you.
marketing.heroSubtitle: Build vocabulary, improve grammar, strengthen listening skills, and make consistent progress every day.
marketing.featuresSubtitle: Everything you need to learn English well, in one focused, distraction-free place.
marketing.featureLessonsDescription: Progress through CEFR-leveled courses and lessons built to develop real fluency, not just vocabulary lists.
marketing.featureVocabDescription: Save any word you come across, track how well you know it, and review it on your own schedule.
marketing.featureListeningDescription: Train your ear with real audio, transcripts, and comprehension checks at every CEFR level.
marketing.featureProgressDescription: See your streak, daily goal, and skill breakdown at a glance, so you always know where you stand.
marketing.step1Description: Take a short placement test and get a CEFR level from A1 to C2.
marketing.step2Description: Work through courses and lessons matched to that level.
marketing.step3Description: Review vocabulary, work through grammar, and train your listening.
marketing.step4Description: Watch your streak, daily goal, and skill breakdown grow over time.
